quote: Now, mind you, the whole collection could probably fit on a Kindle, but at least the cadets will have another place to get out of the rain.
chinese: 话说 全部馆藏估计一个电子阅读器就能装下至少下雨时学员们又多了个地方躲雨
reason: A compact comparison turns a small library into a memorable practical image.

quote: If something's gonna have my name on it, I want to make damn sure they build it right.
chinese: 如果要把我的名字留在上面我得保证那东西建得没什么问题
reason: A crisp standard-setting line converts ownership into accountability.

quote: They taught me the values of honor, duty, and respect. They also hazed me, tried to break me, and, senior year, nearly expelled me when I volunteered for a Senate Race and my studies suffered.
chinese: 我在这儿学到了荣誉 职责和尊重的价值 也曾受到戏弄和打击 大四时险遭开除 那年我志愿参与参议员竞选 致使学业荒废
reason: Balances values with a candid cost-of-success contrast.

quote: How quickly poor grades are forgotten in the shadow of power and wealth.
chinese: 在权力和财富的笼罩下 糟糕的成绩就这样被甩在脑后
reason: A compact aphorism uses a vivid power-and-wealth image.

quote: Your drink is only about half as full as it should be, Frank. Are you trying to get me drunk? Drunk, passed out in the gutter, so I can steal your wife.
chinese: 你这酒杯才一半满嘛 弗兰克 你想把我灌醉吗 灌醉 昏倒在水沟里 这样我就能把你妻子偷走了
reason: Multi-turn comic recognition item; the joke needs the exchange to land.

quote: Oh, not a problem. I was just wondering. Well, shit, Frank, I'm sorry. Don't you sweat it for a second. In fact, here's how you can make it up to me... freshen my drink. That I can do.
chinese: 没关系 只是问一下罢了 真是的 弗兰克 太抱歉了 千万别上火 这样吧 你给我倒点酒 就算补偿我了 没问题
reason: A complete comic repair exchange, useful mainly for recognition and scene understanding.

quote: Sancorp was very disappointed she turned down their donation. I can imagine. And they're also concerned about Peter Russo running for Governor.
chinese: 桑科对她回绝了他们的捐款感到非常失望 不难想象 他们还很关心 彼得·罗素竞选州长一事
reason: Clear plot-facing summary of a donor's reaction and campaign concern.

quote: If I can't find out who's running for governor, I don't deserve a dime of what they're paying me.
chinese: 我连谁在竞选州长都不知道 那我就配不上他们给的酬劳了
reason: A forceful self-standard gives a useful conditional structure.

quote: Remy, congress is in recess, and this weekend is not about work.
chinese: 雷米 国会在休息 这个周末不要谈工作
reason: A concise boundary line with a natural not-about construction.

quote: But my other clients didn't pay for your library or my plane ticket down here. It's a nice little junket for you.
chinese: 但其它客户不会为你的图书馆 和我来这儿的机票买单 对你来说正好旅游了
reason: A plot-bound but memorable way to call out a paid-for favor.

quote: Normally, this is where I would start to drone on about the Sentinel's history, its philosophy, its yadda, yadda, yadda. But I'm going to save that for my big speech tomorrow, and that way I'm not gonna bore y'all to tears twice.
chinese: 通常来说 现在我该开始絮叨 桑蒂诺学院的历史 理念 之类的 但我决定明天正式演讲时再讲这些 这样你们就不用受两次折磨
reason: Self-aware speech framing and a natural bore-you-to-tears idiom.

quote: I first want to thank Sancorp Industries for providing the funds to make the library possible.
chinese: 我首先要感谢桑科工业 为新建图书馆提供资金
reason: A clean opening acknowledgement for a formal thank-you.

quote: I don't know nothing about that stuff. It's over my head.
chinese: 这些事我一窍不通 我听不懂
reason: Natural colloquial admission of limited understanding.

quote: Okay, listen, there's going to be some stories coming out about me in the news... about my past. I just wanted to give you a heads-up so it doesn't catch you off guard.
chinese: 好 听我说 你会在新闻里看到 一些关于我的事 我的过去 我只想给你提个醒 让你有个准备
reason: Useful warning-and-preparation language with a clear heads-up idiom.

quote: You can get a cow up three flights of stairs, but you can't get it down.
chinese: 牵头牛上三段楼容易 牵下来就难了
reason: A memorable contrastive metaphor for a one-way change.

quote: On the library, are they going to put Frank or Francis? Francis. It's the same as the name above the door in my office in the Capitol. Francis is better for libraries. Frank is better for bumper stickers. I got a few of those.
chinese: 图书馆上是写弗兰克还是弗兰西斯 弗兰西斯 和我国会大厦 办公室门上的铭牌一致 弗兰西斯确实更适合命名图书馆 弗兰克更适合作宣传贴纸 我还真那么干过
reason: A naming joke that turns formal and informal register into a memorable contrast.

quote: I want to apologize for when I saw you last time in Washington, how I treated you.
chinese: 我想为上次在华盛顿的时候 我的恶劣态度向你道歉
reason: Direct apology with a specific prior incident and clear repair intent.

quote: And I want to talk about the shipyard. I got a plan to fix it.
chinese: 我还想和你谈谈船厂的事 我想到了补救的办法
reason: Short commitment line that naturally follows an apology.

quote: I'll set you up with a nice, diversified package. Low-risk, high-yield. I think Claire and I have things pretty well under control. If I brought a senior U.S. Congressman into the fund, that would really up my stock in the company.
chinese: 我帮你做个多元化的好投资 风险小 收益高 克莱尔和我能打理好 如果连资深国会议员都投资我的基金 那我在公司可就牛气多了
reason: A compact sales pitch pairs a low-risk/high-yield promise with credibility leverage.

quote: We should sneak in there. Like we used to. I'm game. Do it. Hell, why not?
chinese: 我们溜进去吧 就像以前那样 我参加 就这么定了 何乐而不为呢
reason: Natural reunion invitation with a compact affirmative response sequence.

quote: Split that up between 12,000 members, it's nothing. A couple of weeks' groceries.
chinese: 平分给一万两千人 每人所得寥寥无几 仅够几周的食品杂货
reason: Turns a large headline number into an individual impact calculation.

quote: Listen, there's a community meeting tomorrow. I heard. I'm gonna go over everything in detail. You gonna be there? Wasn't planning on it. I'd like you to be there. Everybody respects you. Want me to vouch for you?
chinese: 听着 明天有一场小区会议 我听说了 我会把一切都详细说明 你会出席吗 没这个打算 我希望你能去 大家都尊敬你 想让我为你做担保
reason: A complete invitation exchange moves from agenda to attendance and personal endorsement.

quote: Listen, I'm gonna tell you something that only a handful of people know. I'm running for governor. I announce soon.
chinese: 听着 告诉你一件事 只有少数几个人知道 我要竞选州长 不久就要宣布了
reason: A high-stakes disclosure with a natural handful-of-people frame.

quote: You show up on my doorstep asking for my forgiveness. Now you want me to be your lapdog after I lost my fucking job?
chinese: 你跑到我家来 求我原谅你 我都失业了 你想让我给你当宠物狗
reason: Recognition item: a sharp challenge built around doorstep and lapdog imagery.

quote: I promise it was a coincidence my assistant booked it.
chinese: 我发誓这纯属巧合 是我助理订的
reason: A concise defensive explanation with a useful coincidence frame.

quote: I wasn't suggesting anything more than a drink. Weren't you? Purely being polite.
chinese: 只是约你喝杯酒 绝没别的意思 是吗 纯属礼貌之举
reason: Subtext-heavy boundary exchange; useful as recognition with context.

quote: Hey, Kenny, I think you got a little too big for this. I think the hole got a lot smaller. Don't let a little girth stop you.
chinese: 肯尼 我看你胖了一圈 钻不过来了 是洞变小了 别让腰围阻挡你的脚步
reason: A comic exchange built on a literal problem and a playful idiom.

quote: Christina, it was really sweet of you to come up here. How do you mean? Seriously, I'm officially convinced you're the most amazing woman I've ever been with, but I meant it when I said I wanted to take this trip alone.
chinese: 克里斯蒂娜 你能来真好 什么意思 说真的 我完全确定 你是我交往过的最好的女朋友 但这次我是真心想自己解决这事
reason: Combines appreciation with a clear personal boundary.

quote: This thing tomorrow isn't going to be pleasant. Which is why I came... to be here for you. Moral support.
chinese: 明天肯定会闹得很不愉快 所以我才来 来支持你 精神支持
reason: Names an unpleasant event and offers support without overexplaining.

quote: Tomorrow's an important day for the campaign. Don't fight me on this.
chinese: 明天对竞选很关键 别跟我争
reason: A concise request that states stakes before setting a boundary.

quote: We just decided not to. There wasn't some big conversation. I think you're lying. Think whatever you want.
chinese: 我们就是不想要 不是什么大事 你在说谎 随你怎么想
reason: A compressed truth-and-denial exchange with natural think-whatever language.

quote: Oh, but it's not a fair fight. You run a rafting company. I sit behind a desk all day.
chinese: 但这不是公平竞争 你开了家漂流公司 而我整天坐在办公室里
reason: A simple contrast that sets up different working lives.

quote: If I can whip congress into submission, I'm not afraid of a little white water.
chinese: 我能让国会俯首称臣 就不怕那点浪花
reason: A confidence metaphor that transfers cleanly from politics to risk.

quote: Do you think this place made us? How do you mean? When I walked on campus today, I wondered, Did it mean anything? If it's just a place we spent four years of our lives... or was there more?
chinese: 你觉得是这里造就了我们吗 什么意思 我今天在校园里走 不禁在想 这地方有意义吗 只是我们度过四年时光的地方 还是有别的意义
reason: A complete reflective question moves from place to identity and meaning.

quote: The library is a sham. Higgins asked me a favor. I asked someone else a favor. They slapped my name on it. Politics. Like everything else.
chinese: 图书馆是个幌子 希金斯要我帮个忙 我让别人帮个忙 他们就把我名字放了上去 和其它事一样 只是政治
reason: Plainspoken accountability turns a public honor into a politics lesson.

quote: You still built something. However long it lasts.
chinese: 你还是造过栋楼 不论它能维持多久
reason: A compact concession that validates work while acknowledging impermanence.

quote: You know why I love rafting? When you're on the water, all you're thinking about is what's right in front of you. Everything is in the moment. I don't really have time to think about the past.
chinese: 你知道我为什么喜欢漂流吗 在水上漂流时 你能想的只有眼前的事 一切尽在这一瞬 真没时间回想过去
reason: A complete explanation links an activity to present-focused thinking.

quote: I'm gonna try to get some shut-eye before the ceremony.
chinese: 典礼开始前我想先去打个盹
reason: Natural everyday rest idiom with a clean before-clause.

quote: You said two years. I think two years is a realistic estimate. If it passes at all. Which I think it will.
chinese: 你说两年时间 我认为两年是比较实际的估计 还是在法案通过的情况下 我认为能通过
reason: Models a cautious forecast that separates the estimate from its condition.

quote: You think or you know? I can't predict 100%, but I'm confident it will.
chinese: 你认为还是能确定 我不敢百分百保证 但我有信心它会通过
reason: Useful uncertainty language pairs a limitation with measured confidence.

quote: Do you wanna know what I think? I think you sit around in Washington coming up with all sorts of fancy numbers and solutions that look good on paper. But that doesn't cut it for the rest of us.
chinese: 你知道我是怎么想的吗 我觉得你整天在华盛顿无所事事 想出一些在文件中看上去很好的 数据和解决方案 对我们来说却根本不适用
reason: A plain-spoken critique contrasts paper solutions with lived outcomes.

quote: We don't eat paper for dinner. You can't put a paper roof over your head. When we all voted for you, I didn't think that every one of those votes was another nail in our own coffin.
chinese: 那些文件不能填饱肚子 也不能用来遮风避雨 我们为你投票的时候 我们都没有想到自己是在 自掘坟墓
reason: Three linked concrete images make an abstract policy failure tangible.

quote: Everybody just sit down for ten minutes. We can go over this proposal point by point and you can get the information that you need to get the resources that you want.
chinese: 大家稍坐十分钟 我们可以逐条讨论这份提议 你们可以获知一切关于 你们所需资源的信息
reason: A practical de-escalation move that offers a point-by-point process.

quote: I understand that they're scared, but that doesn't mean they can't listen.
chinese: 我知道他们害怕了 但也不代表他们不能听取建议
reason: Acknowledges emotion without surrendering the possibility of dialogue.

quote: You didn't grow up with them. I don't need to grow up hand to mouth to empathize with the fact that... they're not interested in empathy.
chinese: 可你没跟他们一起长大 我不需要和他们一起长大 来同情现状… 他们不需要同情
reason: A compact rebuttal distinguishes understanding a situation from sharing its history.

quote: I can convince these people, but I need your help.
chinese: 我能说服这些人 但我需要你的帮助
reason: Clear persuasion goal followed by a direct request for support.

quote: I don't wanna fight you, Petey. I don't wanna fight you either. I will. But we don't have to.
chinese: 我不想打你 彼得 我也不想打你 我会这么做 但我们没必要这样
reason: A compact conflict-repair exchange moves from threat to choice.

quote: What do you want me to do? You elected me to represent you, but I couldn't forestall the inevitable. The shipyard was closing. If not this year, then next. Or the year after. We all know that.
chinese: 你想让我做什么 你们选举我代表你 但我不能阻止不可避免的事 造船厂注定得关闭 不在今年 就是明年 或是后年 我们都清楚
reason: Owns an unavoidable outcome while keeping the timeline explicit.

quote: I could have lied to you. I could have pretended to do more. But I don't believe about living in the past. I only care about the future.
chinese: 我可以对你们撒谎 我可以假装忙活一阵 但我不相信活在过去 我只在乎未来
reason: Contrasts performative promises with a future-facing position.

quote: Now, does what I'm offering you come anywhere near what you want or deserve? No. But you gotta open your eyes and take what's in front of you.
chinese: 我的提议 的确距你们想要的 应得的差得很远 但你们要打开眼界 着眼当前
reason: Admits a gap before reframing the realistic next action.

quote: We can build on that. 5,000 jobs becomes 10,000. Then 15,000. Not in the snap of a finger, but faster than doing nothing will.
chinese: 这是一个基础 五千个工作岗位变成一万个 然后变成一万五千个 的确要等一段时间 但绝对比停滞不前快
reason: Builds a staged growth case with numbers and a clear faster-than-nothing contrast.

quote: Can I count on all of you? All right, I'll take that as a yes.
chinese: 我能指望你们大伙吗 好的 我就当你们默许了
reason: A closing ask converts a hostile room into assumed cooperation.

quote: I wrote a speech. But I'm not gonna read it.
chinese: 我写了一份发言稿 但我不打算读了
reason: A short pivot from prepared text to a personal address.

quote: I don't mean to sound ungrateful. I am very grateful. I'm deeply honored. And I am... I'm very moved.
chinese: 我不是不领情 我很感激 我非常荣幸 而且 非常感动
reason: Models a careful correction that escalates gratitude and emotion.

quote: I had the good fortune of spending most of this weekend with a group of friends. Friends I haven't seen in a very long time. Friends I made here.
chinese: 我有幸和几位好朋友一起度过了 这个周末 很长时间没有见面的好朋友 我在这里交到的朋友
reason: Uses repetition to make a personal thank-you warm and memorable.

quote: Harmony. That's the word that stuck in my mind. Harmony.
chinese: 和谐 这就是一直萦绕在我脑海的词 和谐
reason: A repeated keyword gives a speech an immediate thematic anchor.

quote: It's not about what's lasting or permanent. It is about individual voices coming together. For a moment. And that moment lasts... the length of a breath.
chinese: 与持久或永恒无关 而是不同的声音 汇集在一起 只有那一瞬 那个瞬间 只有一息之长
reason: A complete metaphor about voices, duration, and a breath-long shared moment.

quote: I wanna thank you very much. This is a great honor. I wanna thank president Higgins and of course the love of my life, Claire.
chinese: 我想感谢大家 这是莫大的荣幸 我想感谢希金斯校长 当然还有我一生的挚爱 克莱尔
reason: A formal thank-you sequence lands on a personal dedication.

quote: Things went well today. I think the folks in the yard are gonna get behind me. Peter did a great job.
chinese: 今天很顺利 我想我得到造船厂伙计们的支持了 彼得做得很棒
reason: A concise result report credits both the room and Peter's performance.

quote: The light in my mother's room. I told you I'll take care of it later. No, you'll take care of it now.
chinese: 我妈妈房间里的灯 我说了过会儿会去看的 不行 你现在就得搞定
reason: A natural now-versus-later correction for an everyday request.
